title: 빈손
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop Ballad. Grand piano plays arpeggiated chords in the lower register with a legato melody in the right hand. A baritone male vocal performs with a breathy, emotive delivery, utilizing wide vibrato on sustained notes. Orchestral strings enter with sustained legato pads, primarily cellos and violins providing harmonic thickening. The arrangement features a gradual crescendo in vocal intensity. Key of E Major. Tempo is 72 BPM in 4/4 time.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[grand piano arpeggios]

[Verse 1]
[breathy male vocals]
꽃바구니를 들고 문 앞에 섰다
문고리를 잡았다 놓았다
병원 복도 냄새가 코를 찔러
초록색 슬리퍼가 줄지어 있다
호실 번호를 확인하고 멈춘다 [strings enter, soft legato pads]
커튼 너머로 기침 소리가 들린다
뭐라고 말해야 할지 몰라
